purpose: Machine-readable index for the off-label evidence and authority layer.

provenancePolicy.verified: May be presented as verified against the designated source, subject to the source's scope and effective date.
provenancePolicy.source-derived: Retains explicit source-derived status and must not be presented as independently verified current law.
provenancePolicy.review-required: May guide discovery but requires review before being used as an authoritative proposition.
provenancePolicy.unreviewed: Discovery-only; not suitable for authoritative output.
